_documentation.instructions: This template is used to configure your hospital platform. Fill in the placeholders marked with '[REPLACE WITH: ...]' with genuine hospital information, then save a copy as 'database/seeds/hospital_setup.json'.
_documentation.safety_rule: Do NOT invent fake doctors, qualifications, or clinical credentials. The import command will validate all fields and relations before inserting records.
_documentation.execution_command: Run 'python backend/manage.py import_hospital_data --file database/seeds/hospital_setup.json --dry-run' to validate without writing, then run without '--dry-run' to import.
